title: Battery Power Estimator
text: Calculate maximum charging and discharging power of battery pack over time horizon, 2 inputs, 2 outputs, {Algorithm data type} sets Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit:; {Vector of state-of-charge values, SOC (-)} sets the sOC breakpoints, {Vector of temperatures, T} sets the temperature, {No-load voltage, V0(SOC,T), (V)} sets the v 0 lookup table 3.55, 3.57, 3.56; 3.62, 3.63, 3.64; 3.71, 3.71, 3.72; 3.91, 3.93, 3.94; {Charging pulse test resistance, R0Dt(SOC,T), (ohm)} sets the charging resistances over pulse of Δt seconds, {Discharging pulse test resistance, R0Dt(SOC,T), (ohm)} sets the discharging resistances over pulse of Δt seconds, {Cell capacity, AH (A*Hr)} sets the battery capacity when fully charged, {Number of series modules, Ns} sets the number of modules in series, {Number of parallel modules, Np} sets the number of modules in parallel, {Charging efficiency ratio} sets the ratio of charging efficiency, {Minimum cell voltage (V)} sets the minimum voltage of cell, {Maximum cell voltage (V)} sets the maximum voltage of cell, {Minimum state of charge, SOCmin(-)}, {Maximum state of charge, SOCmax(-)}, {Minimum pack current (A)} sets the minimum current of pack, {Maximum pack current (A)} sets the maximum current of pack, {Minimum cell power (W)} sets the minimum power of battery, {Maximum cell power (W)} sets the maximum power of battery and {Time horizon (s)}. Values come from the instance.
